# Renaise Kim

> Selected public portfolio work by Renaise Kim, designer and curator.

[Public work index](https://renaise.com/work/) · [Interactive portfolio](https://renaise.com/)

## Public case studies

- [Idler](https://renaise.com/work/idler/): Identity + launch site for an AI research company. Role: Brand Designer.
- [Osmosis](https://renaise.com/work/osmosis/): An identity for task-specific AI. Role: Brand Designer.
- [SOOT](https://renaise.com/work/soot/): A library organized by visual similarity. Role: Lead Product Designer.
- [FLORA](https://renaise.com/work/flora/): A node canvas for AI image + video models. Role: Founding Designer.
- [Maestro](https://renaise.com/work/maestro/): Programming + membership in one product. Role: Design Lead.
- [Aputure](https://renaise.com/work/aputure/): A website for a global lighting catalog. Role: Art Director + Designer.
- [The Depictions of Original Sin](https://renaise.com/work/depictions-of-original-sin/): AI film screening with Flow x Artifice. Role: Creative Director.
- [Biota](https://renaise.com/work/biota/): Imagine anything, seed everything. Role: Designer.
- [Studio Artifice](https://renaise.com/work/studio-artifice/): The studio’s identity + website. Role: Founder + Creative Director.
- [Lighthouse](https://renaise.com/work/lighthouse/): A website for U.S. visa applications. Role: Lead Designer.
- [The Artifact Index](https://renaise.com/work/the-artifact-index/): An archive of creative process. Role: Creative Director.
- [Artifice Brand Identity](https://renaise.com/work/artifice-brand/): The identity for Artifice NYC. Role: Creative Director.
- [ARTIFACTORY](https://renaise.com/work/artifactory/): A browser-based 3D design tool. Role: Designer + Developer.
- [CineBox](https://renaise.com/work/cinebox/): Finding film references by mood + color. Role: Designer + Developer.
- [Vamos](https://renaise.com/work/vamos/): Multiplayer itinerary planning for travel. Role: Design Director.
- [Fielder](https://renaise.com/work/fielder/): Browsing images by likeness + color. Role: Designer + Developer.
- [Moshpit](https://renaise.com/work/moshpit/): Turning saved media into shared collections. Role: Designer + Developer.
- [Codex Foundry](https://renaise.com/work/codex-foundry/): A home for independent software. Role: Founder.
- [Mythra](https://renaise.com/work/mythra/): A protocol for summoning websites into chat. Role: Co-author.
- [rememe](https://renaise.com/work/rememe/): A creation-first social app for remixing. Role: Product Designer.
